headline: NEW BOSS, FULL IN-TRAY: BRANDON CRAIG TAKES BHP HELM JULY 1 AS IRON ORE STRIKES, URANIUM PUSH AND M&A HEAT LOOM
snippet: Brandon Craig, 53, officially becomes CEO of BHP on July 1, 2026, succeeding Mike Henry after leading the company's Americas growth strategy. Craig's first day arrives with threatened strikes at Western Australian iron ore operations, ballooning project costs, investor pressure to pursue uranium ('I'll have a really good look at it, but scale is hard,' he told one fund), and a febrile M&A backdrop — all while BHP shares trade near record highs on the copper-and-data-centre demand thesis.

headline: 615,000 OZ AuEq AT UNDER $20/OZ DISCOVERY COST: MITHRIL SILVER UPGRADES COPALQUIN TARGET 1 TO 75% INDICATED (TSXV:MSG)
source_name: Small Caps / Mithril Silver and Gold
snippet: Mithril Silver and Gold (TSXV:MSG / ASX:MTH) released a mine-constrained, diluted resource upgrade at Copalquin Target 1 in Durango, Mexico on June 30, 2026: 615,000 oz gold-equivalent at a discovery cost of under US$20/oz AuEq, with 75% (464,000 oz AuEq) now in the higher-confidence Indicated category — a 196% jump versus the prior estimate. The Indicated component grades 3.15 g/t gold and 77.8 g/t silver across 3.39 million tonnes, achieved after 60,000 metres of drilling in 204 holes.

headline: 204 METRES AT 2.05% ZnEq AT 834M DEPTH — BERRIGAN MINE POLYMETALLIC DEEP ZONE CONFIRMED IN CHIBOUGAMAU (TSXV:LOT)
snippet: TomaGold Corp (TSXV:LOT) released July 1, 2026 assays from extension hole TOM-25-011EXT at the Berrigan Mine Project in the Chibougamau Mining Camp, Quebec: a 204.25-metre mineralized envelope at 2.05% ZnEq from 834 metres depth, with sub-intervals including 31.31% ZnEq over 2.40m and 4.62% ZnEq over 14.40m. The results confirm a deeply rooted polymetallic hydrothermal system of zinc, gold, silver, and copper beneath the historic Berrigan Mine; Globex Mining holds a 2% gross metal royalty on the underlying land package.

headline: 4,982 G/T SILVER OVER 7.5 METRES AT SURFACE: ARGENTA MAPS 20+ NEW TARGETS AT EL QUEVAR IN ARGENTINA (TSXV:AGAG)
snippet: Argenta Silver Corp (TSXV:AGAG) reported June 30, 2026 surface and drill results at El Quevar in Salta Province, Argentina: best intercepts include QVD-433 returning 4,982 g/t Ag over 7.50 metres (including 6,850 g/t Ag over 4.50m) and a new zone returning 1,385 g/t Ag over 4.0 metres at the emerging Mani-Copan target. More than 20 priority silver targets are now defined across three exploration corridors, with a regional ground magnetic survey 89% complete and metallurgical test work expected by Q3 2026.

headline: KODIAK ADDS SECOND RIG, EXPANDS MPD COPPER-GOLD PROGRAM 2.5X TO 16,500 METRES IN B.C.'S SOUTH OKANAGAN (TSXV:KDK)
snippet: Kodiak Copper Corp (TSXV:KDK) announced June 29, 2026 that it is expanding its 2026 exploration program at the MPD copper-gold porphyry project in southern British Columbia from 6,500 metres to 16,500 metres and adding a second drill rig — with all seven deposits in the existing Mineral Resource Estimate open to expansion in multiple directions. Early holes at the Ketchan deposit (2,546 metres completed in 14 holes) have exceeded the company's geological model expectations, prompting the significant program increase.

headline: BEIJING MOVES TO STRIP PBOC OF GOLD TRADE OVERSIGHT — CHINA'S PROPOSED RULE CHANGE COULD OPEN PHYSICAL GOLD FLOWS
snippet: Chinese regulators published June 28–29, 2026 draft revisions to gold import and export rules that would remove the People's Bank of China from its joint oversight role for individuals carrying gold across borders, consolidating supervision under Customs alone. The proposal follows June 1 reforms that already expanded multi-use gold trade permits to nine-month validity with unlimited qualifying transactions; analysts see the reforms as a sustained push to liberalize China's cross-border gold market, potentially increasing physical import volumes at a time when spot prices near US$4,000 are attracting bargain buying in Asia.

headline: ATLAS LITHIUM SECURES BRAZIL EXPANSION PERMIT AT NEVES — DFS PROJECTS 145% IRR AND 11-MONTH CAPEX PAYBACK (ATLX)
snippet: Atlas Lithium Corporation (ATLX) received the expansion environmental licence for its 100%-owned Neves Project in Minas Gerais, Brazil — the final major regulatory hurdle before project construction as contemplated in the Definitive Feasibility Study, which projects a 145% IRR and an 11-month capital payback period. Neves is the only Brazil-based lithium asset included in the Japan-US critical minerals cooperation agreement; a fully manufactured processing plant has been delivered to site and assembly is underway.

headline: GOLD'S DEATH CROSS FLASHES FOR FIRST TIME IN 18 MONTHS — STONEX WEEKLY ROUNDUP: SEASONAL LOW TYPICALLY LATE JULY
snippet: StoneX's June 29, 2026 weekly precious metals report by head of market analysis Rhona O'Connell flags that gold's 50-day moving average has crossed below the 200-day — a 'death cross' — for the first time in approximately 18 months, as the metal trades near its seven-month low below US$4,000. O'Connell notes that seasonal analysis consistently places either late July or early August as the annual low for gold and the miners, suggesting the worst of the technical selling pressure may still lie ahead before a historically typical summer recovery.

headline: FALLING OIL TO RESCUE PRECIOUS METALS? HERAEUS SAYS GOLD MARKET IS SHIFTING EAST AS WESTERN SELLERS NEAR EXHAUSTION
snippet: Heraeus Metals' June 29, 2026 weekly precious metals analysis argues that Brent crude returning below US$75/bbl — near pre-war levels — should reduce PCE inflation expectations and lower the implied probability of a Federal Reserve rate hike, creating a structural positive for gold and silver without any change in Fed policy. The report also highlights an ongoing structural shift in gold's demand centre of gravity toward Asia, with Chinese and Indian physical buying re-emerging strongly near US$4,000 while Western futures remain speculator-dominated and short-skewed.

headline: TWO RIGS MOBILIZING IN JULY: VIOR GOLD TARGETS CAMERON MAIN GOLD ZONE AT KINEBIK IN ABITIBI, ACQUIRES NEW GROUND (TSXV:VIO)
snippet: Vior Gold Corporation (TSXV:VIO) announced June 30, 2026 that the first of two diamond drill rigs will mobilize to the Kinebik Project (40 km northeast of Lebel-sur-Quévillon, Quebec) during the first week of July, with a second rig following in week three, targeting the high-priority Cameron Main zone directly southeast of the historic Cartwright showing. The company also announced property acquisitions expanding the Kinebik land package; drilling is conditional on receipt of outstanding wood-cutting permits expected imminently.
